summary: Serpentine tables are curved half-oval or quarter-round pieces. Four make a closed circle about 12 ft across that seats about 16; four in an S seat about 22 over about 24 ft; two make a U. Rental houses sell matching curved linens. Reclaimed-wood serpentines are a named designer pick. Built as a quarter of a 12 ft ring, 30 in deep.
